title: Guide is fork-only; never open an Embabel PR
body: Layer B stays on jmjava/guide (or orch-guide). Opening, drafting, or offering an Embabel/guide pull request is forbidden. The orchestrator rule no-embabel-guide-upstream.mdc is the standing policy.

title: Headings-only canvas is not a contract
body: grep for ## headings is not C-COMPLY. gate_check(code) requires Metadata or frontmatter readiness that allows coding, a non-empty Requirements section, a T## operation with Status, and a Files mapping. A headings-only canvas must fail.

title: Query capture metrics from record.metrics, not session.body
body: FEAT-015 stores readiness, review_result, rework, context_files, validate_cycles, and review_cycles on record.metrics. sdlc-engine context metrics --construct does not parse session.body. kind=metric was not restored. Body tags remain a human copy for live-consumer greps.

title: Spring Boot example has no Java; first eval slice used hello gold
body: examples/spring-boot-order-api has no *.java sources. TEST-001 stop rule forbids scoring C-DRIFT against a missing implementation. The first slice gold is tests/eval/test-002-hello/. Do not mutate tests/live-consumer/seed/.

title: Until REF-001, Python gate_check is the research SUT
body: Shell sdlc.sh and Python gate_check can disagree. Milestone 2 evaluation uses SDLC_ENGINE=python. Shell-without-Python is not a second experimental condition. REF-001 still owns a single gate semantics.

title: Archive contracts, not the lessons ledger
body: sdlc.sh archive may move or delete canvas, analysis, review, sync, and matching session briefs. It must not truncate, filter, or delete spdd/memory/lessons.jsonl. Decision, pitfall, and pattern records are the dogfood memory that survives Complete work leaving the working tree.

title: Pitfall: REF-002-purge-pre-v3-compat
body: Do not report a merged work item fully complete while post-merge checks or lifecycle records remain open; verify the merge commit and reconcile canvas, requirement, milestone, roadmap, review, sync, and ledger state.

title: Pattern: REF-002-purge-pre-v3-compat
body: Use a post-merge close-out matrix: terminal merge-commit CI, product-to-shipped doc mirror comparison, stale-contract grep, operation-diff scope, lifecycle status reconciliation, review artifact, accepted lesson records, and sync artifact.

body: One-way spec-to-template inventory checks do not detect orphan templates that have no spec; require reverse inventory or an explicit contract assertion for exceptional commands.

title: Pattern: CHORE-006-dogfood-adapters-and-quick-spec
body: Move an existing hand-maintained adapter under generation by first encoding its current behavior, then require a zero generated diff before accepting source-of-truth ownership.

title: Decision: REF-003-retire-bash-workflow-dual-path
body: Shell harnesses resolve their interpreter through one shared tests/lib/engine-python.sh helper instead of each pinning the repo .venv, because CI installs the engine into the job interpreter and never creates a repo venv.

title: Pitfall: REF-003-retire-bash-workflow-dual-path
body: resolve_engine_python read the interpreter version into 'read -r major minor' via a here-string; when the interpreter could not run at all the here-string still fed read one empty line, so read returned 0 and the guard printed a truncated 'is 3.' version instead of reporting an unrunnable interpreter. Detect the empty version string before parsing.

title: Pattern: REF-003-retire-bash-workflow-dual-path
body: The diff complexity gate fails on any CCN rise in a touched function, so growth belongs in a new extracted helper (_shell_script_candidates/_resolve_shell_script) rather than inline in the existing function. The gate reads git HEAD, not the working tree, so it must be re-run after committing.
